title: Immunocore announces R&D leadership evolution
summary: Immunocore announces R&D leadership evolution Dr. David Berman will depart the Company Dr. Mohammed Dar, Chief Medical Officer, and Mark…...
body_text: Immunocore announces R&D leadership evolution January 30, 2026 7:00am EST Download as PDF Immunocore announces R&D leadership evolution Dr. David Berman will depart the Company Dr. Mohammed Dar, Chief Medical Officer, and Mark Moyer, Head of Regulatory Sciences, promoted to Executive Vice President roles (OXFORDSHIRE, England & RADNOR, Penn. & GAITHERSBURG, Md., US, 30 January 2026) Immunocore Holdings plc (Nasdaq: IMCR) (“Immunocore” or the “Company”) , a commercial-stage biotechnology company pioneering and delivering transformative immunomodulating medicines to radically improve outcomes for patients with cancer, infectious diseases and autoimmune diseases, today announced that Dr. David Berman, Executive Vice President, Research and Development, will leave the Company effective 27 February 2026. Dr. Berman has accepted a Development Head role at a large commercial-stage biotech company. Immunocore does not intend to seek a direct replacement for Dr. Berman and will instead streamline its R&D structure and leverage the existing experienced leadership team. The Company is promoting Dr. Mohammed Dar, its current Chief Medical Officer, and Mark Moyer, its current Head of Regulatory Sciences, to Executive Vice President (EVP) roles, assuming expanded oversight of clinical development and regulatory strategies. “David has been instrumental in delivering the Phase 3 trial that has led to the approval of KIMMTRAK, and in positioning our rich pipeline for success including three ongoing Phase 3 trials,” said Bahija Jallal, Chief Executive Officer at Immunocore . “We are confident in our world-class R&D organization, leadership and ability to deliver on our near-term milestones and long-term vision. I thank David for his partnership and wish him well.” "Along with Mark and our talented R&D colleagues, I am firmly committed to delivering our strategic priorities including progressing our ongoing clinical programs, as we continue to bring transformative therapies to patients," said Dr. Mohammed Dar, Chief Medical Officer at Immunocore . Dr. Mohammed Dar brings extensive experience leading early- and late-stage programs at various companies. He has been leading clinical development since 2019 and has direct oversight of all clinical programs across the Company’s oncology, infectious disease, and autoimmune portfolios, as well as advanced KIMMTRAK® (tebentafusp-tebn) to regulatory approval. During his previous 16-year career at GSK, Medimmune, and AstraZeneca, he oversaw the development of pazopanib, moxetumomab, and durvalumab, which led to FDA approvals. Mark Moyer, who joined Immunocore in 2018, will become EVP, Chief Regulatory and Quality Officer. He led the regulatory strategy for KIMMTRAK – now approved in 39 countries. During his over 35 years in the pharmaceutical industry, Mark has provided global strategic regulatory leadership for drug development – including over 35 Biologics License Applications (BLAs) and Marketing Authorisation Applications (MAAs) – with notable examples such as nivolumab, elotuzumab, ipilimumab and dasatinib. About Immunocore Immunocore is a commercial-stage biotechnology company pioneering the development of a novel class of TCR bispecific immunotherapies called ImmTAX – Immune mobilizing monoclonal TCRs Against X disease – designed to treat a broad range of diseases, including cancer, autoimmune diseases and infectious diseases. Leveraging its proprietary, flexible, off-the-shelf ImmTAX platform, Immunocore is developing a deep pipeline in multiple therapeutic areas, including clinical and pre-clinical programs​ in oncology, infectious diseases, and autoimmune diseases. The Company’s most advanced oncology TCR therapeutic, KIMMTRAK, has been approved for the treatment of HLA-A*02:01-positive adult patients with unresectable or metastatic uveal melanoma in the United States, European Union, Canada, Australia, and the United Kingdom. Forward Looking Statements This press release contains “forward-looking statements” within the meaning of the safe harbor provisions of the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995. Words such as “may”, “will”, “believe”, “expect”, “plan”, “anticipate”, “aim”, “continue”, “target” and similar expressions (as well as other words or expressions referencing future events or circumstances) are intended to identify forward-looking statements. All statements, other than statements of historical facts, included in this press release are forward-looking statements. These statements include, but are not limited to, statements regarding the promotion of Dr. Mohammed Dar and Mark Moyer and Immunocore’s ability to deliver on its strategic priorities, including progressing on its clinical programs; and deliver transformative medicines to patients. Any forward-looking statements are based on management’s current expectations and beliefs of future events and are subject to a number of risks and uncertainties that could cause actual events or results to differ materially and adversely from those set forth in or implied by such forward-looking statements, many of which are beyond the Company’s control. These risks and uncertainties include, but are not limited to, the impact of worsening macroeconomic conditions on the Company’s business, financial position, strategy and anticipated milestones, including Immunocore’s ability to conduct ongoing and planned clinical trials; Immunocore’s ability to obtain a clinical supply of current or future product candidates or commercial supply of KIMMTRAK or any future approved products; Immunocore’s ability to obtain and maintain regulatory approval of its product candidates, including KIMMTRAK; Immunocore’s ability and plans in continuing to establish and expand a commercial infrastructure and to successfully launch, market and sell KIMMTRAK and any future approved products; Immunocore’s ability to successfully expand the approved indications for KIMMTRAK or obtain marketing approval for KIMMTRAK in additional geographies in the future; the delay of any current or planned clinical trials, whether due to patient enrollment delays or otherwise; Immunocore’s ability to successfully demonstrate the safety and efficacy of its product candidates and gain approval of its product candidates on a timely basis, if at all; competition with respect to market opportunities; unexpected safety or efficacy data observed during preclinical studies or clinical trials; actions of regulatory agencies, which may affect the initiation, timing and progress of clinical trials or future regulatory approval; Immunocore’s need for and ability to obtain additional funding, on favorable terms or at all, including as a result of worsening macroeconomic conditions, including changes in inflation and interest rates and unfavorable general market conditions, and the impacts thereon of the war in Ukraine, the conflict in the Middle East, and global geopolitical tension; Immunocore’s ability to obtain, maintain and enforce intellectual property protection for KIMMTRAK or any of its product candidates it or its collaborators are developing; and the success of Immunocore’s current and future collaborations, partnerships or licensing arrangements. These and other risks and uncertainties are described in greater detail in the section titled "Risk Factors" in Immunocore’s filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission, including Immunocore’s most recent Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2024 filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on February 26, 2025, as well as discussions of potential risks, uncertainties, and other important factors in the Company’s subsequent filings with the SEC. All information in this press release is as of the date of the release, and the Company undertakes no duty to update this information, except as required by law. title: Web Dev Rundown: The C3 Programming Language, Popular HN Blogs, and POSSE Publishing
summary: A new systems programming language challenges C, analysis reveals what makes technical blogs succeed on Hacker News, and the POSSE principle shows how to own your content while reaching wider audiences.
body_text: Three conversations on Hacker News today reveal different aspects of modern development: a new systems programming language challenging C, analysis of which blogs resonate with the HN community, and the POSSE principle for content distribution. Each offers practical insights for developers building web applications. C3: A Modern Alternative to C The C3 Programming Language caught attention today as developers explored alternatives to C that maintain performance while improving safety and developer experience. The discussion reveals both curiosity about new approaches and healthy skepticism about reinventing foundational tools. C3 positions itself as "C with refinements"—maintaining C's performance characteristics while adding modern language features: Memory safety features without garbage collection overhead Better error handling with result types and optionals Module system for better code organization Compile-time execution for metaprogramming Improved generics over C's macro system Why This Matters for Web Developers Most web developers don't write systems code daily, but understanding systems languages helps when: Building performance-critical components - WebAssembly enables running compiled languages in browsers. Projects requiring extreme performance benefit from systems languages. Understanding infrastructure - Tools you depend on—databases, servers, runtimes—are often written in systems languages. Understanding these patterns makes you better at optimizing your applications. Evaluating trade-offs - The conversation around C3 highlights tensions between familiarity and improvement, performance and safety, simplicity and features. These same tensions exist when choosing web frameworks and libraries. The discussion emphasizes that successful languages balance multiple concerns. C3 attempts this by staying close to C while adding targeted improvements rather than reimagining everything. The Most Popular Blogs on Hacker News An analysis of the most popular blogs on Hacker News in 2025 sparked discussion about what content resonates with developers. The conversation reveals patterns about technical writing and community preferences. What Makes Content Resonate The analysis shows successful technical content typically: Solves real problems - Articles that help developers fix issues, understand concepts, or build features get shared and discussed. Shows depth - Surface-level tutorials don't perform as well as deep dives that reveal underlying principles. Demonstrates expertise - Content from practitioners with real experience carries more weight than theoretical discussions. Explains clearly - Complex topics presented accessibly perform better than academically rigorous but impenetrable writing. Implications for Content Strategy For teams building technical blogs and documentation: Write from experience - Share what you've actually built and learned, not what you think developers want to hear. Go deep - Don't just skim the surface. Explain the why behind the how. Developers appreciate understanding principles, not just copying code. Focus on utility - Content that solves problems or teaches valuable skills gets shared. Entertainment value alone isn't enough. Be specific - Generic advice about "best practices" rarely resonates. Specific examples, real code, and concrete scenarios work better. This connects directly to content management platforms. The best CMSs enable creating in-depth technical content efficiently—supporting code blocks, technical diagrams, and structured examples without fighting the editor. POSSE: Publish on Your Own Site, Syndicate Elsewhere The POSSE principle generated extensive discussion about content ownership and distribution strategy. The conversation reflects developers' ongoing tension with platform dependency. The Core Principle POSSE stands for "Publish (on your) Own Site, Syndicate Elsewhere." The strategy: Create content on your own domain - Your website is the canonical source Own your content and URLs - Platform changes don't break your links or control your distribution Syndicate to platforms - Share on social media, Medium, DEV.to, but link back to your site Maintain control - If platforms change policies or shut down, your content persists Why This Matters Now Recent platform changes—Twitter becoming X, Reddit API restrictions, Medium's evolving paywall—remind developers that platforms change policies unilaterally. POSSE provides insurance: Content longevity - Your domain and hosting outlast individual platforms SEO benefits - Canonical URLs on your domain build your site's authority Brand consistency - Your site reflects your design and voice, not platform constraints Analytics control - You see complete traffic data, not filtered platform metrics Implementation with Modern CMSs POSSE works best with CMSs designed for it: API-first architecture - Content accessible via API enables automatic syndication to multiple platforms Webhook support - Trigger syndication automatically when publishing new content Canonical URL management - Track where content syndicates and maintain proper canonical links Multi-channel publishing - Manage content once, distribute everywhere Cosmic's API-first approach supports POSSE naturally. Create content once, distribute through APIs to your website, social platforms, email newsletters, and mobile apps—all from a single source. Connecting the Themes These discussions share common principles: 1. Ownership and Control Matter C3 gives developers more control over memory and performance. POSSE gives creators control over content distribution. Both reject unnecessary dependencies on external systems. For web applications, this means: Choose platforms that don't lock in your content Use standard APIs and formats Maintain export capabilities Control your deployment pipeline 2. Learn from the Past, Improve for the Future C3 evolves C rather than replacing it entirely. Popular HN blogs build on established formats while adding unique perspectives. POSSE updates old-school blogging for the social media era. Apply this to your stack: Don't chase every new framework Understand why existing tools work Adopt improvements that solve real problems Avoid changes just for novelty 3. Depth Beats Breadth Successful content goes deep rather than covering everything superficially. Successful languages focus on specific improvements rather than solving all problems. For your projects: Focus on core features done extremely well Deep expertise in one area beats shallow knowledge of many Solve specific problems thoroughly Add features that genuinely improve user experience Practical Takeaways For Systems-Level Thinking Even if you don't write C or C3: Understand how compiled languages differ from interpreted ones Learn basic memory management concepts Appreciate performance implications of language choices Follow systems programming to understand infrastructure better For Content Creation If you're building technical content: Write from real experience and projects Go deeper than tutorials—explain principles Solve actual problems developers face Make complex topics accessible Publish on your own domain first For Platform Choices When selecting CMSs and tools: Prioritize content ownership and portability Choose API-first platforms for distribution flexibility Avoid platforms that lock in your content Maintain canonical URLs on your domain Use tools that enable POSSE workflows Building for the Long Term The threads connecting these discussions point toward sustainable development practices: Own your infrastructure - Whether it's content, code, or deployment, maintain control over critical systems. Learn fundamentals - Understanding systems programming concepts, writing principles, and distribution strategies outlasts specific tools. Choose portable solutions - Platforms change, but standard formats and APIs provide stability. Focus on quality - Depth, expertise, and utility matter more than volume or novelty. Modern CMS for POSSE Workflows Cosmic's architecture supports these principles: API-first design - Content accessible via standard REST APIs Your domain, your content - Export anytime, no lock-in Multi-channel distribution - Publish to website, social media, email from one source Webhook automation - Trigger syndication workflows on publish Fast global delivery - Sub-100ms API responses worldwide Explore our API documentation to see how straightforward content distribution can be when your CMS is built for modern workflows. Conclusion Today's discussions—from systems programming evolution to content strategy to distribution principles—all emphasize ownership, depth, and learning from the past while building for the future. Whether you're evaluating new programming languages, creating technical content, or choosing infrastructure, these principles apply: maintain control over what matters, go deep rather than broad, and build on solid foundations rather than chasing trends. The best tools and strategies stand the test of time not because they're perfect, but because they solve real problems while remaining flexible enough to evolve. This daily roundup covers the C3 programming language, analysis of popular technical blogs, and the POSSE content distribution principle. For more insights on building modern web applications, explore the Cosmic blog .

title: IA en AgendaPro: cómo Julia y Sofía convierten mensajes en citas y ventas
summary: AgendaPro es el primer software para gestión y crecimientos de negocios que usa IA. Descubre cómo mejora tu negocio.
body_text: La IA ya no es una ventaja competitiva opcional; es una necesidad para negocios que quieren crecer en un mercado donde los clientes esperan respuestas inmediatas en sus canales preferidos. Julia y Sofía representan esa solución dentro de AgendaPro, el único software que trabaja con IA: una forma de convertir cada mensaje en una oportunidad de venta y cada cita en un cliente satisfecho. ¿Listo para unirte a los negocios que ya están transformando su gestión con inteligencia artificial? Solicita una demo personalizada y descubre cómo la IA de AgendaPro puede funcionar específicamente para tu salón, spa, clínica o centro de bienestar. IA en AgendaPro: oportunidad para salones y clínicas La inteligencia artificial ya no es ciencia ficción ni algo reservado para grandes empresas de tecnología. Hoy, negocios de belleza, bienestar y salud en Latinoamérica están adoptando herramientas de automatización inteligente para transformar la forma en que atienden clientes, gestionan citas y generan ingresos. Sin embargo, el dato es contundente: solo 3 de cada 10 negocios en México utilizan IA para tareas como agendamiento, confirmaciones y atención al cliente. E sto significa que el 70% restante sigue dependiendo de procesos manuales que consumen cuánto tiempo podrían invertir en atender mejor a sus usuarios. El problema actual es conocido por cualquier dueño de salón, clínica o spa: Mensajes de WhatsApp e Instagram que se acumulan sin respuesta Citas sin confirmar que terminan en espacios vacíos Cancelaciones de última hora sin posibilidad de reagendar Pérdida de ventas por no responder a tiempo cuando un cliente potencial pregunta por un servicio AgendaPro, una plataforma SaaS especializada en salones, spas, clínicas y centros de estética, lleva años ayudando a más de 10.000 negocios nos recomiendan a digitalizar sus operaciones. Ahora, la integración de agentes de IA llamados Julia y Sofía transforma la forma en que estos negocios convierten conversaciones en citas y citas en ingresos. Todo funciona dentro del ecosistema de AgendaPro: la agenda centralizada, los pagos, los recordatorios, el CRM y las herramientas de marketing . Julia Sales AI: tu vendedora 24/7 en WhatsApp, Instagram y Facebook Imagina tener una vendedora que nunca duerme, nunca se enferma y nunca pierde la paciencia. Eso es exactamente lo que Julia Sales AI ofrece a negocios de belleza, bienestar y salud. Julia es un agente de IA que responde mensajes, agenda citas y procesa cobros las 24 horas del día, los 7 días de la semana. Todo esto ocurre sin que ningún empleado tenga que intervenir manualmente. Los canales soportados incluyen: WhatsApp Business Instagram Direct Facebook Messenger Todos conectados directamente a la plataforma de AgendaPro. Ejemplo concreto: Un salón de belleza en México recibe un mensaje a las 11:30 de la noche preguntando por disponibilidad para un balayage. Julia responde al instante, ofrece los servicios disponibles, muestra horarios para el día siguiente y envía un link de pago para confirmar la reserva. A la mañana siguiente, el equipo del salón encuentra una cita confirmada y pagada esperándolos. Conversaciones automatizadas que venden más La magia de Julia está en cómo guía la conversación desde el primer saludo hasta la reserva confirmada. Utilizando procesamiento de lenguaje natural y machine learning . El flujo típico de una conversación con Julia sigue este patrón: Saludo inicial → Julia da la bienvenida y pregunta en qué puede ayudar Identificación del servicio → El cliente menciona lo que busca Propuesta de horarios → Julia consulta la agenda en tiempo real y ofrece opciones disponibles Confirmación → El cliente elige su preferencia Pago → Julia envía el link para procesar el cobro y asegurar la cita Cada conversación queda registrada automáticamente en el CRM de AgendaPro, lo que permite al negocio hacer seguimiento posterior, enviar promociones personalizadas y entender mejor el comportamiento de compra de sus clientes. Respuestas inmediatas para no perder oportunidades La velocidad importa. Responder en menos de 1 minuto en WhatsApp puede aumentar significativamente la tasa de cierre cuando un cliente llega desde anuncios de redes sociales. Julia ofrece: Tiempos de respuesta instantáneos, sin importar la hora del día Visualización de horarios disponibles al momento Solución a objeciones típicas sobre precio, duración del servicio, ubicación y formas de pago Atención consistente que no depende del estado de ánimo de un empleado Cuando un negocio invierte en campañas de Meta Ads en Facebook e Instagram, cada lead que llega al chat recibe atención inmediata. Esto maximiza el retorno de la inversión publicitaria porque ningún mensaje queda sin respuesta. Reactivación de conversaciones y citas canceladas No todas las conversaciones terminan en reserva al primer intento. Julia detecta silencios largos (por ejemplo, más de 24 horas sin respuesta del cliente) y envía mensajes de seguimiento automáticos para retomar la conversación. También actúa cuando una cita se cancela: Detecta la cancelación en el sistema Escribe al cliente inmediatamente Ofrece 2 o 3 opciones nuevas para reprogramar esa misma semana Caso concreto: Una clienta cancela su cita de manicure el mismo día por la mañana. Julia le escribe automáticamente, le ofrece tres franjas horarias disponibles para los próximos días y la clienta reagenda para el viernes. El espacio que pudo quedar vacío se llena sin que la recepcionista tuviera que hacer una sola llamada. Esta reactivación reduce la pérdida de ingresos por cancelaciones de última hora y mantiene la agenda llena y estable. Mayor conversión desde anuncios y botón de WhatsApp La integración de Julia con campañas publicitarias funciona así: El negocio crea anuncios en Facebook o Instagram con botón de “Enviar mensaje a WhatsApp” Cada clic abre un chat que Julia atiende inmediatamente Julia responde, agenda y cobra sin que el equipo tenga que intervenir Los beneficios medibles incluyen: Mayor porcentaje de leads que terminan en cita confirmada y pagada Capacidad de escalar campañas sin saturar al equipo de recepción Menor costo por adquisición de cliente La automatización permite que más inversión en anuncios tenga sentido. Cada mensaje se convierte en una oportunidad bien atendida, no en un prospecto perdido por falta de respuesta rápida. Sofía: la asistente de IA que ordena tu agenda y reduce ausencias Si Julia es la vendedora, Sofía es la organizadora. Este agente de IA se encarga de cuidar cada cita una vez que está creada, enviando notificaciones, confirmando asistencia y reagendando cuando es necesario. Sofía trabaja integrada con la agenda centralizada de AgendaPro, lo que la hace ideal para salones, clínicas, spas, barberías y centros médicos que manejan múltiples profesionales y servicios. El objetivo es claro: reducir significativamente la tasa de no-show y citas olvidadas mediante mensajes automáticos por sms y WhatsApp. Recordatorios automáticos por WhatsApp Sofía envía mensajes de recordatorio personalizados antes de cada cita. El negocio puede configurar los tiempos según sus necesidades: Recordatorio 24 horas antes de la cita Recordatorio 2 horas antes de la cita Confirmación el día anterior Cada mensaje incluye: Fecha y hora exacta de la cita Nombre del profesional asignado Dirección del local o link de ubicación Instrucciones especiales si aplica Ejemplo de mensaje: “Hola María, te recordamos tu cita de coloración con Laura mañana jueves 15 a las 3:00 PM en nuestro salón de Polanco. ¿Confirmas tu asistencia? Responde SÍ o escríbenos si necesitas cambiar tu horario.” Estos recordatorios mejoran la percepción de profesionalismo del negocio y reducen drásticamente los olvidos de los clientes. Reagendación inteligente de citas canceladas Cuando un cliente responde que no puede asistir, Sofía no solo registra la cancelación. Inmediatamente ofrece nuevas franjas horarias disponibles, consultando la agenda en tiempo real. El flujo funciona así: El paciente o cliente responde que no puede asistir Sofía consulta la disponibilidad actual del profesional Propone 2 o 3 opciones concretas para esa misma semana El cliente elige y la cita queda reprogramada Ejemplo: Un paciente cancela su consulta médica la noche anterior. Sofía le envía un mensaje con tres alternativas disponibles para los próximos días. El paciente elige una opción y confirma sin que la recepcionista haya tenido que hacer una sola llamada. Esto ayuda a mantener el calendario lleno y aprovechar mejor la capacidad instalada del negocio. Menos huecos vacíos significan más ingresos por día. Más tiempo libre para el equipo y mejor experiencia del cliente Al delegar recordatorios y reagendaciones en Sofía, recepcionistas y administradores pueden dedicarse a lo que realmente importa: Atención presencial de calidad Tareas administrativas de alto valor Venta de productos adicionales Resolución de problemas complejos Los clientes, por su parte, reciben una experiencia moderna: comunicaciones claras, ordenadas y sin esperas. La IA mantiene un tono coherente y profesional en todos los mensajes, alineado con la identidad de marca del negocio. Para el dueño, esto significa menos estrés. Ver una agenda organizada que prácticamente se administra sola gracias a la facilidad de uso de la automatización es una de las ventajas más valoradas por los usuarios de AgendaPro. Datos y reportes en tiempo real para decisiones más inteligentes Todo lo que hacen Julia y Sofía se mide dentro de AgendaPro. No se trata solo de automatizar, sino de entender qué está funcionando y qué puede mejorarse. El negocio puede acceder a reportes detallados sobre: Número de conversaciones atendidas por la IA Citas creadas, canceladas y reprogramadas Ventas generadas a través de cada canal Tasa de confirmaciones exitosas Porcentaje de no-shows antes y después de activar los recordatorios Estos reportes se actualizan en tiempo real, permitiendo ajustar campañas de anuncios, promoción AgendaPro de servicios específicos y horarios de atención según la demanda real. Los indicadores clave que puedes controlar incluyen: Indicador Qué mide Por qué importa Tasa de respuesta Porcentaje de mensajes respondidos por Julia Evalúa cobertura de atención Conversión a cita Conversaciones que terminan en reserva Mide efectividad de ventas Tasa de no-show Citas que no se presentan Identifica pérdidas por ausencias Reprogramaciones exitosas Citas canceladas que se reagendan Muestra recuperación de ingresos Medición de rendimiento de campañas y canales AgendaPro permite identificar desde qué canal llegan más reservas: WhatsApp Business Instagram Direct Facebook Messenger Formulario web Esto ayuda a las empresas a comparar el rendimiento antes y después de activar Julia Sales AI en sus anuncios. También permite detectar horarios pico de mensajes y ajustar turnos de personal en el local. Ejemplo práctico: Un spa en Guadalajara descubre a través de los reportes que sus campañas lanzadas después de las 9 PM generan un 40% más de reservas que las de horario laboral. Esto ocurre porque Julia atiende esos mensajes nocturnos cuando antes quedaban sin respuesta hasta el día siguiente. Con esta información, el negocio decide aumentar su inversión publicitaria en horarios nocturnos. El enfoque de análisis predictivo permite tomar decisiones basadas en datos, no en intuiciones. Aunque no seas un experto en tecnología, los dashboards de AgendaPro presentan la información de forma clara y accionable. Cómo empezar a usar la IA en AgendaPro en tu negocio Implementar Julia y Sofía en tu negocio es más sencillo de lo que imaginas. Estos son los pasos para comenzar: Paso 1: Contar con una cuenta activa de AgendaPro donde ya tengas configurada tu agenda, servicios y profesionales. Paso 2: Configurar la integración con sistemas existentes como WhatsApp Business, Instagram y Facebook Messenger desde el panel de AgendaPro. Paso 3: El equipo de AgendaPro te acompaña en la configuración inicial de Julia y Sofía: mensajes base, horarios de atención, servicios disponibles y reglas de automatización. title: Exposing Online Manipulation Behind Iran’s Anti-Protest Campaign
summary: While nationwide protests in Iran have surged in the past month, Cyabra has conducted a deep analysis of online discourse to uncover the forces seeking to influence the grassroots protests of the Iranian people.
body_text: While nationwide protests in Iran have surged in the past month, Cyabra has conducted a deep analysis of online discourse to uncover the forces seeking to influence the grassroots protests of the Iranian people. TL;DR A coordinated fake campaign tried countering the Iranian protests by promoting the Ayatollah-led regime and delegitimizing the US 25% of profiles discussing Iran's protests were inauthentic The fake campaign reached an estimated 6.6 million views with coordinated messaging supporting Iran's current regime, and created the illusion of widespread support online Lebanese-origin accounts dominated the inauthentic network, indicating a cross-border influence operation The Numbers Behind the Pro-Ayatollah Manipulation Cyabra analyzed social media discourse surrounding the protests in Iran against the Islamic regime from December 1, 2025, to January 18, 2026. The investigation spanned X, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok, revealing a coordinated inauthentic campaign designed to counter the protests by promoting the Ayatollah-led regime and delegitimizing the United States. On X, 25% of profiles discussing the Iranian protests were inauthentic. These fake accounts generated 26% of all content on this topic, demonstrating significant investment in narrative manipulation. The inauthentic profiles operated in a synchronized manner, creating the impression of widespread support for regime-friendly narratives. The campaign’s potential impact is striking: an estimated 6.6 million views amplifying the regime’s messaging during a critical period of civil unrest. What distinguishes this operation is the geographic origin of the fake campaign. Cyabra identified that a significant number of inauthentic profiles originated from Lebanon, providing concrete evidence of a pro-Iranian influence operation manipulating public opinion from outside Iran despite internet blackouts and access restrictions within Iran itself. A coordinated network that promoted anti-U.S and pro-Ayatollah mess Coordinated Tactics: Hashtags, Messaging, and Amplification The campaign deployed sophisticated coordination tactics centered around a specific Arabic-language hashtag: مع_ايران_ضد_العدوان # which means “With Iran against the aggression” – the aggression being the United States. This slogan expressed support for Iran and opposition to perceived external aggression, particularly from the US. Numerous inauthentic profiles shared coordinated content supporting Khamenei as Iran’s rightful leader while framing the United States as a terrorist actor. The campaign’s content was primarily disseminated in Arabic, indicating a targeted effort to influence audiences across the Arab and Muslim world, not just within Iran. This cross-regional approach demonstrates sophisticated audience segmentation by the campaign operators. Blurring Lines: Fake Accounts Leverage Authentic Engagement A sophisticated aspect of this campaign was the integration of authentic and inauthentic activity. Cyabra discovered that alongside fake profiles, many authentic accounts also used the same hashtag, blurring the line between coordinated manipulation and organic discourse. This hybrid approach represents an evolution in discourse manipulation. By entangling authentic engagement with coordinated inauthentic behavior, the campaign created an environment where distinguishing between genuine public opinion and manufactured sentiment became increasingly difficult. The organic amplification enabled the campaign to reach broader audiences and strengthen its perceived authenticity. This approach parallels what Meta identified and disrupted in other Iranian influence operations during 2025, where fake personas manipulated public opinion. Fake profiles shared posts in Arabic that supported the Iranian Regime Broader Implications for Democratic Governments The Iranian anti-protest campaign reveals the sophisticated nature of cross-border influence operations that target specific language demographics and leverage regional relationships. The coordination of messaging across platforms and languages, while blending authentic and inauthentic engagement, creates significant detection challenges. Such operations aren’t limited to Iran. Similar tactics have been observed in influence campaigns targeting electoral processes in democratic nations. State actors increasingly utilize sophisticated digital tools to influence both domestic and international audiences. The Lebanon-Iran connection highlights the importance of understanding regional proxy relationships in digital influence operations. By operating through Lebanon-based accounts, the campaign maintained activity despite internet restrictions within Iran. For government agencies protecting democratic processes, this campaign offers critical lessons: Continuously monitoring and analyzing online discourse during political crises is essential for early detection of coordinated campaigns. Cross-platform analysis is crucial for identifying synchronized messaging across multiple social media environments. Developing rapid response protocols to identify and counter inauthentic campaigns is vital: The speed with which these operations generate millions of impressions means delayed responses significantly reduce counter-measure effectiveness. Advanced disinformation detection technologies enable identification of coordinated inauthentic behavior before maximum impact. By analyzing engagement patterns, account origins, and content similarity, these tools provide crucial early warnings. The Iranian anti-protest campaign represents a warning of increasingly sophisticated tactics influencing public discourse around critical political movements. By implementing appropriate detection and response mechanisms, democratic governments can better protect the information environment and society as a whole from similar manipulation attempts. title: Fingerprint vs. Facial Recognition: Which Biometric Device Is Right for Your Team?
summary: Fingerprint or facial recognition? Discover which biometric attendance system offers better accuracy, hygiene, and payroll efficiency.
body_text: In today's fast-paced business environment, effective workforce management is crucial for boosting productivity, ensuring accuracy, and maintaining security. Traditional methods like manual attendance using pen-and-paper registers, punch cards, ID cards, or PINs are prone to errors in manual attendance, fraudulent entries, proxy attendance, buddy punching, and time theft. These issues lead to payroll leakage, inflated labour costs, and reduced employee morale due to lack of accountability. Enter biometric attendance systems, advanced solutions that use unique biometric identifiers such as fingerprints, facial scans, iris patterns, or even voice authentication to automate the authentication process. A biometric time attendance system provides real-time logging, precise time stamps, detailed attendance reports, overtime tracking, and seamless payroll integration and HR integration. This not only eliminates time fraud prevention but also offers real-time insights into absenteeism, helping businesses reduce payroll processing errors and achieve labour costs reduction. Among the most popular options are fingerprint recognition and facial recognition systems. Both fall under biometric attendance machines and leverage biometric authentication for secure employee enrollment and verification. But which one is better suited for your team, especially in diverse settings like corporate offices, manufacturing industry, healthcare, education, retail, construction sites, field services, or mobile workforce scenarios involving remote teams and hybrid teams? In this comprehensive guide, we'll explore the evolution of attendance tracking, compare fingerprint scanning and face identification, discuss emerging trends like AI integration, contactless attendance, and multi-modal biometrics, and highlight why modern solutions like SalaryBox's devices stand out in the growing Indian biometrics market. The Evolution from Manual to Biometric Attendance Systems Before biometrics, businesses relied on outdated systems: Pen-and-paper registers : Prone to manual errors and fraudulent activities. Punch cards and ID cards : Easily shared, leading to buddy punching and proxy attendance. PINs : Forgettable and shareable, compromising security. These methods caused significant payroll leakage and hindered operational efficiency. The shift to biometric systems revolutionized time and attendance solutions by using irreplaceable biological traits for biometric verification. Today, biometric attendance software integrates with cloud computing for real-time data, cloud storage, and mobile attendance tracking. Features like geofencing, shift management, overtime rules, and absenteeism prediction make them indispensable for work shifts and multiple shifts. In India, the biometrics market is booming, driven by labor laws, regulation compliance, and the need for accurate calculations in payroll. Costs vary: entry-level machines start at ₹4,000–₹8,000, mid-range machines at ₹9,000–₹15,000, and high-end machines up to ₹25,000, depending on hardware specs, software features, and integrations. Understanding Biometric Identifiers Biometrics rely on unique traits: Fingerprints : Ridge patterns for fingerprint recognition. Facial scans : Analyzing unique facial features via AI in facial recognition. Iris patterns : Highly accurate but less common for attendance. Voice recognition or vein pattern/palm print : Niche options. Advanced systems use gait analysis or multi-modal fusion for enhanced reliability. Key metrics include False Acceptance Rate (FAR) and False Rejection Rate (FRR), lower rates mean better enhanced accuracy and fewer false positives or false negatives. Fingerprint Recognition: Pros and Cons Fingerprint recognition has been a staple in biometric attendance machines for years. Pros: Cost-effective: Lower hardware costs and total cost of ownership (TCO). High accuracy in controlled environments with clean, dry hands. Proven fraud prevention against buddy punching. Easy employee enrollment and fast authentication. Reliable for high-security environments and access control. Cons: Requires physical contact, raising hygiene concerns, especially post-pandemic. Issues with dirty, wet, worn, or injured fingers lead to false negatives. Not ideal for construction sites, manufacturing, or roles with glove usage. Maintenance requirements like sensor cleaning and firmware updates. Less suitable for remote employees or field employees. Fingerprint systems excel in small offices or environments with consistent conditions but fall short in hygienic solutions demand. Facial Recognition: The Modern, Contactless Choice Facial recognition attendance uses AI-powered biometric technology to map facial landmarks, offering a touch-free access experience. Pros: Contactless attendance: Promotes hygiene and contactless operations—ideal for healthcare, education industry, and post-pandemic workplaces. Fast authentication, even from a distance with AI-driven liveness detection and anti-spoofing to prevent photo/video fraud. Handles variations in lighting, angles, masks, or beards via advanced algorithms. User-friendliness and quick enrolment. Supports mobile-based biometrics and integrations for hybrid teams. Better scalability and reliability in diverse conditions. Cons: Slightly higher upfront investment due to cameras and AI processing. Potential privacy concerns (addressed via data encryption, GDPR/CCPA compliance, and consent management). Rare issues with extreme lighting or heavy disguises. Facial systems shine in contactless solutions, reducing maintenance costs and enabling touch-free access. Key Comparison: Fingerprint vs. Facial Recognition Aspect Fingerprint Recognition Facial Recognition Hygiene Contact-based; germ spread risk Contactless; hygienic solution Accuracy High but affected by finger condition Enhanced with AI; adapts to changes Speed Fast but requires precise placement Faster; glance-based Security Good; hard to fake Excellent with liveness detection Cost in India Lower (₹5,000–₹12,000) Mid-to-high (₹9,000–₹25,000) Best For Indoor offices, small businesses Large enterprises, hybrid/remote teams False Rates Higher FRR with damaged fingers Lower overall with anti-spoofing Facial recognition often wins for elimination of proxy attendance, cost and time saving, improved efficiency, and streamlined workflows. Emerging Trends in Biometric Attendance AI integration for better fraud detection. Cloud vs on-premises: Cloud offers real-time alerts, dashboard analytics, and role-based access control. Multi-factor authentication and multi-modal biometrics. Mobile apps with geofencing for remote employees. Privacy and compliance: Data encryption, audit trails, employee consent, and adherence to Information Technology Rules 2011. Future: Wearable biometrics, blockchain audit trails. These trends favor facial recognition for futuristic attendance management. Spotlight on SalaryBox Devices: Leading the Indian Market In the competitive Indian biometrics market, SalaryBox offers innovative, cost-effective solutions tailored for SMEs, startups, and large enterprises. SalaryBox Gamma : An AI facial recognition biometric attendance machine with touchscreen, Wi-Fi/LAN connectivity, up to 1,000–10,000 user capacity, and massive transaction storage. Features AI-driven liveness detection, offline mode, and seamless payroll software integration. Priced around ₹13,999–₹18,000, it's perfect for corporate offices, manufacturing, and construction with its reliability and anti-tampering design. SalaryBox Face Scan Pro : A more affordable face scan pro device at around ₹9,990, supporting up to 5,000 faces, HD cameras for varying lighting, mask detection, and inbuilt Wi-Fi. Ideal for small businesses, educational institutions, and retail needing hygienic solutions and visitor access management. Both integrate with SalaryBox's cloud-based app for real-time attendance tracking, leave and attendance management, customized reporting, analytics, and HR software compatibility. They support mobile workforce with geofencing and ensure data privacy via secure storage. SalaryBox devices provide excellent return on investment (ROI) through reduced maintenance costs, time fraud prevention, and automated workflows. With strong vendor support and manufacturer support, they're top choices for affordable biometrics in India. Factors to Consider When Choosing a Biometric System Security needs : Sensitive data? Opt for advanced encryption and security measures. Team size and type : Small office? Fingerprint. Hybrid/remote? Facial. Industry : Dusty sites? Avoid fingerprints. Hygiene-critical? Facial. Budget : Include software licensing, implementation costs, network requirements. User experience : Ease of integration, reporting capabilities, data management. Compliance : Labour laws, privacy laws. For most modern teams, facial recognition offers superior enhanced security, streamlined processes, and transparency. Conclusion: Facial Recognition for the Win in Most Scenarios While fingerprint recognition remains reliable and cost-effective for specific use cases, facial recognition emerges as the superior choice for its contactless, hygienic, and versatile nature. It addresses hygiene compliance, supports remote teams, and integrates AI for unmatched accuracy and fraud prevention. Devices like SalaryBox Gamma and Face Scan Pro exemplify the best in AI-powered biometric technology, making them ideal for Indian businesses seeking operational efficiency and accurate payroll. Investing in the right biometric attendance system boosts productivity, fosters accountability, and ensures regulation compliance, paving the way for growth. FAQs 1. What is the difference between fingerprint and facial recognition in biometric attendance systems? Fingerprint requires touch for scanning ridges, while facial uses AI to analyze features contactlessly—making facial more hygienic and faster. 2. Which is more accurate: fingerprint or facial recognition? Both are highly accurate, but facial with AI liveness detection often has lower error rates in real-world conditions, especially with variations like masks or lighting. 3. Are facial recognition systems hygienic? Yes, they are fully contactless, eliminating germ spread—perfect for post-pandemic workplaces and hygiene-focused industries. 4. How do biometric systems prevent proxy attendance and buddy punching? By using unique biological traits that can't be shared, ensuring only the enrolled person can mark attendance. 5. What is the cost of biometric attendance machines in India? Entry-level around ₹5,000–₹10,000, mid-range ₹10,000–₹15,000, high-end ₹15,000+—with facial models like SalaryBox Face Scan Pro starting at ₹9,990. 6. Which biometric device is best for small businesses? Affordable facial options like SalaryBox Face Scan Pro offer great value with cloud integration and easy setup. 7. Can these systems integrate with payroll software? Yes, advanced ones like SalaryBox seamlessly integrate for automated overtime, leaves, and salary calculations. 8. Is facial recognition secure against spoofing? Modern devices use AI liveness detection to distinguish real faces from photos/videos. 9. Which is better for construction sites or dusty environments? Facial recognition, as it avoids sensor issues from dirt or gloves common in fingerprint systems. 10. Why choose SalaryBox Gamma or Face Scan Pro? They combine AI accuracy, cloud app, Wi-Fi connectivity, large capacity, and seamless payroll/HR integration, making them the best option for reliable, hygienic, and scalable attendance management in India.

title: ION826
summary: ION826 jfrazier@ionis.com Fri, 01/30/2026 - 13:58 Drug Name ION826 Target PLN Disease Myocardial Disease Description ION826, also known as AZD4063, is an investigational siRNA medicine in development for a serious form of myocardial disease called PLN-R14del dilated cardiomyopathy. ION826 uses Bicycle® technology, a Bicycle peptide ligand with high affinity to the transferrin receptor (TFR1) to deliver antisense medicines to muscle tissue, including in the heart. It is the first Bicycle-conjugated siRNA to reach clinical trials. This program is partnered with AstraZeneca. About PLN R14del dilated cardiomyopathy PLN-R14del dilated cardiomyopathy is a serious form of myocardial disease caused by a mutation in the phospholamban (PLN) gene, where the arginine at position 14 (R14del) is deleted. With no approved disease-modifying therapies, people living with the PLNR14del mutation are at higher risk of heart muscle weakening, malignant ventricular arrhythmias and heart failure. Safety and efficacy have not been evaluated by any regulatory authorities for the indication described. Partner AstraZeneca Phase 1 Phase one Therapeutic Area Cardiometabolic Disease Display Order 4

title: Energizing the Broncos and Empower Field at Mile High
summary: We are proud to serve Broncos Country
body_text: Empower Field at Mile High has changed names through the years, but one thing remains the same: the energy of Broncos Country. But what about the energy that keeps Mile High powered up each and every day? “The amount of power and energy that it takes to run a stadium like this is similar to that of a small city,” says Chris Hoag, project manager, Empower Field at Mile High. “We have everything from commercial kitchens to office buildings, all the way out into the parking lots, to the top of the light rack for all the sports lights, down to the headset cards and replay cards on the sidelines for football.” With over 200 events a year and up to 2 million people coming through the doors annually, powering a small city isn’t an exaggeration. It takes 13,000 volts to keep the power on at Empower Field, and in a 1.9 million square foot stadium, that energy needs to be nearby and distributed constantly. That’s why there are five substations housed here; the fifth substation was added in 2023 just to bring all the power necessary for the new scoreboard. “With a stadium like ours, reliable power is required,” says Zach Myhra, senior director, Facilities, Empower Field at Mile High. “Our game day experience is something that we can't fail at. We have to be successful. Xcel Energy is our behind-the-scenes partner, providing that reliable energy for us that allows us to provide a great game day experience.” For over a century, Xcel Energy has powered the state of Colorado. We’re proud to help bring the energy to game day and every day.

title: 2025: Taking carbon capture and storage from momentum to impact
summary: ExxonMobil executive outlines 2025 milestones in carbon capture business, and looks ahead to 2026 carbon capture ​advancements and projects to support industry-wide emissions reduction.
body_text: Carbon capture and storage (CCS) has been around since the 1970s, but the world is finally starting to sit up and take notice of this powerhouse technology for decarbonizing heavy industry and meeting growing demand for low-carbon products. In a time where energy demand is enormous AND decarbonization goals are on the global clock, ExxonMobil’s Low Carbon Solutions business is taking big steps to expand and strengthen our CCS operations along the U.S. Gulf Coast — one of the world’s most crucial hubs for energy production and heavy industry. 2025 highlights In 2025, we reached some important milestones for our CCS operations and laid the groundwork for future scaling. First startup - We started up operations to transport and store up to 2 MTA of CO2 from CF Industries’ Donaldsonville complex in Louisiana , our first CCS project to come online. New customers - We contracted with AtmosClear and Lake Charles Methanol II to transport and store up to 2 MTA CO2 emissions cumulatively from their respective projects in Louisiana. These partnerships bring our CCS portfolio to six customers and ~9 MTA of CO2 contracted. Expanded reach - We grew our portfolio of industries served to include power and methanol, in addition to our previous contracts supporting steel, ammonia, natural gas processing and industrial gases. This demonstrates the wide range of applications that can be transformed by CCS. Looking ahead to 2026 In the coming year, we plan to begin operations on multiple CCS projects in Texas and Louisiana and expand our capabilities for capturing carbon emissions at industrial sources. Next projects - We’re scheduled to start capturing CO2 from the New Generation Gas Gathering (NG3) natural gas processing facility in Louisiana, and look forward to starting up CCS operations with our customers Linde and Nucor this year as well. New markets - We expect to reach a final investment decision by the end of the year for our first Low Carbon Data Center (LCDC). Data demand is growing exponentially in the world today, and ExxonMobil is uniquely able to address this need with a low carbon solution using natural gas power generation, abated by CCS. Same commitment - We plan to continue our work to engage with stakeholders at the community, state, and federal levels, being good neighbors in the communities where we operate and proactive participants in permitting and regulatory processes. We want to ensure the important work of CCS application can thrive, expand, and support our communities. CCS is not new technology, but it’s flown relatively under the radar compared with the attention that production of hydrocarbons commands. Now as the world becomes more aware of the need to reduce emissions, CCS finally has a brighter spotlight and a broader runway to scale up. We’re in it for the long haul. We see CCS’s limitless potential for improving industries, communities, and the world, and we’re confident that each new contract, each permit, each step is a building block to lowering emissions. CCS is here to stay, and we’re committed to being part of its legacy.
